scope: Offline extraction of saved checkpoints, params, and real simulator assessments. No retraining or simulator rerun. Current source locations are later accumulated working files, not independent historical code revisions.

definitions.full20: Mean across the full 20s trial, body frame vx/vy
definitions.cycle: Common 0.54s boxcar, first 2s excluded; identical assessor definition for initial and improved forward
definitions.world_xy: Endpoint world displacement; mean signed values across trials
definitions.heading: Unwrapped final heading change from initial orientation, degrees
definitions.after2: Mean body velocity or instantaneous planar speed after first2s
